versions.description: Initial release with comprehensive Starwind UI component reference
changes: Added complete Starwind UI component library integration
Created comprehensive AGENTS.md quick reference files for 11 components
Implemented dropdown, card, table, item, breadcrumb, sidebar, tabs, pagination, theme-toggle, aspect-ratio, and separator components
Added component documentation with usage patterns and API references
Configured Tailwind CSS v4 with custom theme variables
Set up project structure with layouts, styles, and utilities
